summary: Track 25B Operator Walk Certification — 10-task walk executed end-to-end as Super Admin (jaymn.judd@mascigc.com). Sidebar IA reduction is CORRECTLY IMPLEMENTED: 'Admin OS' section has all 10 canonical domain links; new 'Platform Tools' section carries the 3 preserved children (Database Capacity, Multi-Factor Auth, Platform Self-Protection); the old 'Operations Control Center' top-level section and its duplicate 'Operations Console' link are GONE. All 10 walk tasks completed via sidebar clicks only. Zero visual drift across the shell. Zero V1/V3/Hub/Switcher language on operator-facing surfaces. A single 'V2' reference remains in the OCC Email Routing card action text (borderline — describes technical mode, not a heading). Two functional issues surfaced (Governance & Trust landing stuck in a partial-loading state showing 0/0 cards; OCC highlight/pulse animation for maintenance deep-link not visibly detected). One testability gap: AdminBreadcrumb missing data-testid='admin-breadcrumb' hook.

ui_bugs.issue: Page never finishes loading its trust cards — shows 'Loading governance & trust evidence…' and every section (Certification & Deploy, Governance Rules & Version, Audit Trail) reports 0/0 card(s). Deploy Readiness / Unresolved Deploy Blockers / Production Certification cards are NOT rendered on the landing (they DO render correctly on Diagnostics via the same APIs, so the source data is healthy). Header still says HEALTHY 0 · ATTENTION 0 · CRITICAL 0 with LAST REFRESHED '—'. Refresh spinner stays on 'Refreshing…'.

Deep-link /admin/operations-control?highlight=storage.safe_cleanup navigates correctly, but no .animate-pulse / [data-highlight=true] / [data-highlighted=true] element found for the target op card. Cannot visually confirm the correct op card is being highlighted for the operator.

Breadcrumb renders (visible text 'ADMIN OS › STORAGE & RECOVERY') and has aria-label='Breadcrumb', but the expected data-testid='admin-breadcrumb' hook is missing on every domain page. Makes the crumb un-targetable by data-testid.

On the Admin OS domain landings (Governance & Trust · OCC), clicking the 'Admin OS' crumb text did not fire a navigation (no anchor/button role found on the crumb). Walk Task 7 (return to /admin via breadcrumb) fell through to sidebar fallback. Verify the leftmost crumb is rendered as an <a> or <button> and not a static <span>.

issues: Section header collapses by default — first-time operators may not see Database Capacity / MFA / Self-Protection children until expanded. Consider open-by-default OR small child count preview.
